name: Maple

seo.title: Maple — Normal bear cub
seo.description: Gentle normal cub who fits cottage and pumpkin-patch seasons without trying.

acnh.intro: Maple is a normal bear cub villager in the who appears in all games to date. Her name may come from ''maple'' trees, which are known to bear light-brown leaves, referring to Maple's fur color. Her catchphrase, "honey," refers to how bears enjoy eating honey.
acnh.appearance: Maple is a brown bear cub with cream-colored muzzle, hands, and feet, soft bangs, black nose, and pink blush on her cheeks. Earlier designs shrank her eyes and shifted her muzzle tan; New Horizons gives her dark brown eyebrows and a red ribbon tied at the back of her head, cozy as a storybook cub.
acnh.personality: Maple embodies normal calm — kind, caring, easily upset by lazy misunderstandings and cranky scheming that misleads her in conversation. Fishing and bug catching keep her gently active without turning hobbies into competition. House visits may come with apologies for mess she shares with other normal villagers who worry their homes look unclean. In older games she mentions Moppina, a mop friend reflecting her tidy streak and quiet hygiene concerns. Peppy and normal neighbors feel sisterly in talk; snooty and smug villagers appreciate her good nature, though lazy food chatter can accidentally offend when she tries to be helpful. Patience and kindness unlock a neighbor who wants everyone's day a little softer, offering steady warmth once trust is earned over many unhurried visits and gentle favors.
